name: myhotlunchbox-mcp
description: School lunch ordering for Claude — browse the lunch calendar, manage students, place and change orders, and track payments on a My Hot Lunchbox parent account

myhotlunchbox_username.title: My Hot Lunchbox Email
myhotlunchbox_username.description: The email address you sign in to ordernow.myhotlunchbox.com with

tools.name: mhlb_apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a coupon code to the account.

tools.name: mhlb_apply_gift_card
tools.description: Redeem a gift card code onto the account balance.

tools.name: mhlb_checkout
tools.description: PAY for the lunches in the cart.

tools.name: mhlb_create_order
tools.description: Place a lunch order into the cart.

tools.name: mhlb_create_student
tools.description: Add a student to the account.

tools.name: mhlb_delete_order
tools.description: Cancel a lunch order.

tools.name: mhlb_delete_student
tools.description: Remove a student from the account.

tools.name: mhlb_get_calendar
tools.description: Get the lunch calendar for the account over a date range: which days are open for ordering, already ordered, paid, in the cart, subscribed or closed, per student.

tools.name: mhlb_get_cart
tools.description: Get the shopping cart — lunches added but not yet paid for.

tools.name: mhlb_get_cart_tabs
tools.description: Get the valid filter values for mhlb_get_cart — the ordering periods (semesters) and status tabs, with which one is selected by default.

tools.name: mhlb_get_coupon
tools.description: Get the coupon currently applied to the account, if any.

tools.name: mhlb_get_day
tools.description: Get what a student has ordered on one specific date — the items, sizes, quantities, add-ons and prices.

tools.name: mhlb_get_menu
tools.description: Get the orderable menu for one student on one date — the vendor, items, sizes, add-ons, prices and the ordering deadline.

tools.name: mhlb_get_order
tools.description: Get an existing order in editable form — the model mhlb_update_order expects back.

tools.name: mhlb_get_order_form
tools.description: Get the blank order model for a student on a specific lunch event — the exact structure that mhlb_create_order expects back, pre-populated with the available items.

tools.name: mhlb_get_student_form
tools.description: Get the editable profile for one student — school, grade, teacher, delivery location, allergies and the dropdown options for each.

tools.name: mhlb_get_subscription_settings
tools.description: Get the account’s subscription configuration — whether recurring ordering is on, and its terms.

tools.name: mhlb_get_transaction
tools.description: Get the line-item detail of one transaction — which lunches it paid for.

tools.name: mhlb_healthcheck
tools.description: Resolves the credential the way real tools do, then makes one authenticated request to ordernow.myhotlunchbox.com.

tools.name: mhlb_init_checkout
tools.description: Start checkout for the cart: returns the order summary, totals, taxes, applied credits and the available payment methods.

tools.name: mhlb_list_gift_cards
tools.description: List gift cards on the account — codes, balances and status.

tools.name: mhlb_list_students
tools.description: List the students on the account: id, first name, school, grade/teacher, whether they have orders, and whether the profile is inactive or still an unaccepted invite.

tools.name: mhlb_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List upcoming lunch subscriptions — the recurring orders that will be placed and charged automatically.

tools.name: mhlb_list_transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions on the account — date, amount, and what was paid for.

tools.name: mhlb_new_student_form
tools.description: Get a blank student profile plus the school/grade/teacher dropdown options, ready to fill in and pass to mhlb_create_student.

tools.name: mhlb_print_calendar
tools.description: Generate the printable lunch calendar PDF for a date range.

tools.name: mhlb_print_orders
tools.description: Generate the printable order-details PDF for a single lunch date.

tools.name: mhlb_print_transaction
tools.description: Generate the printable receipt PDF for one transaction.

tools.name: mhlb_remove_coupon
tools.description: Remove the coupon currently applied to the account.

tools.name: mhlb_session_reset
tools.description: Discard the cached My Hot Lunchbox access token so the next tool call signs in again.

tools.name: mhlb_set_subscription_enabled
tools.description: Turn recurring lunch subscriptions on or off for the account.

tools.name: mhlb_unsubscribe_order
tools.description: Stop a recurring subscription for a specific lunch order.

tools.name: mhlb_update_order
tools.description: Change an existing lunch order.

tools.name: mhlb_update_student
tools.description: Update a student profile.

tools.name: mhlb_whoami
tools.description: Get the signed-in My Hot Lunchbox account: name, email, role, number of students, pending order count, account credit balances, and whether subscriptions are enabled.
